chunks: By no means. In fact they do not fear the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that disbelievers do not fear the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual blindness of those who neglect the Hereafter, contrasting their complacency with the prophetic call to accountability. It underscores the concept of *ghaflah* (heedlessness) as a root cause of moral decay, urging believers to cultivate *khawf* (awe) of divine judgment as a means of spiritual purification.
